name: The Plaza of the Palm Beaches
aka: Trump Plaza of the Palm Beaches
address: 525 & 529 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Plaza of the Palm Beaches is a pair of 32-story condominium towers on South Flagler Drive with views of the Intracoastal Waterway. The towers opened in October 1985 and carried the Trump Plaza name from 1986 until 2021, when owners voted to change it.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
parking: Assigned underground garage parking, valet and guest parking
description: The Plaza of the Palm Beaches is a pair of 32-story towers at 525 S Flagler Drive, on the Intracoastal Waterway in downtown West Palm Beach, with Intracoastal, ocean and city views. Armour Guider Development Corporation developed the towers to a design by Schwab & Twitty Architects, and they opened in October 1985. The Bank of New York foreclosed in January 1986, and Donald Trump bought the property that July and renamed it Trump Plaza; in 2021 residents voted to restore the name The Plaza. Amenities include a heated pool, spa, sauna, tennis, a fitness center and a community room, with concierge service and 24-hour security.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of The Plaza of the Palm Beaches

name: Esplanade Grande
address: 201 S Narcissus Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Esplanade Grande is a 15-story boutique condominium on the west side of Flagler Drive, built above the downtown waterfront amphitheater near Clematis Street. It has about four residences per floor, each opening from a private elevator foyer.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (number and size limits)
parking: Assigned underground garage parking with private elevators; valet
description: Esplanade Grande is a 15-story building with 63 residences, about four per floor, on the west side of N Flagler Drive directly above the Meyer Amphitheatre, within walking distance of Clematis Street. East-facing residences look over the Intracoastal Waterway toward Palm Beach Island and the Atlantic Ocean. Residences run from about 1,900 to 3,000 square feet, and some original buyers combined adjacent units into homes of about 6,000 square feet. Amenities include a heated rooftop pool and spa, a rooftop garden, a clubroom, a fitness center, a 24-hour concierge and valet parking.

name: 101 Lofts
address: 101 N Clematis St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: 101 Lofts is a five-story loft-style condominium at the east end of Clematis Street. It overlooks the Clematis Street fountains, the Waterfront Green and the Intracoastal Waterway.
petPolicy: Pets allowed
rentalPolicy: Leasing limited to two tenants per year
description: 101 Lofts is a five-story building at the east end of Clematis Street, across Flagler Drive from the Waterfront Green and the Intracoastal Waterway, overlooking the Clematis Street fountains. Completed in 2002 in a coastal Mediterranean style, it has commercial space on the first two floors and 60 original loft residences on floors three to five, some since combined. The building has a keypad/card-access lobby with a door attendant and no pool or clubhouse.

name: The Strand
address: 255 Evernia St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Strand is a 15-story tower with 275 units and ground-floor retail, on the downtown block between Evernia and Datura streets. It opened as a rental building in 2002 and was converted to condominiums after it was sold in 2005.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
rentalPolicy: Leasing limited to two leases per year
description: The Strand is a 15-story, 275-residence building at 255 Evernia Street, on the block between Evernia and Datura streets in downtown West Palm Beach. American Land Housing Group developed it as a mixed-use rental project with about 13,728 square feet of ground-floor shops, designed by Dorsky Hodgson + Partners, and it opened in 2002. In 2005 it sold to Margolias Realty Group, a condominium conversion firm, and it now operates as a condominium. Upper east-facing floors have Intracoastal and distant ocean views, and amenities include a heated rooftop pool and hot tub, a fitness center, a billiards room and a lobby attendant.

name: 610 Clematis
address: 610 Clematis St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: 610 Clematis is an eight-story condominium on Clematis Street, built around a central courtyard. The courtyard holds a pool, a sundeck and a zen garden.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
parking: Assigned underground garage parking for residents and guests
description: 610 Clematis is an eight-story, low-rise courtyard building at Clematis Street and Rosemary Avenue in downtown West Palm Beach, completed in 2006. Residences surround a central courtyard with a heated infinity pool, sundeck, spa and zen garden, and the building also has a fitness center, steam room, saunas and bike storage. Security includes a full-time lobby attendant and a camera system with overnight guards.

name: City Palms
address: 480 Hibiscus St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: City Palms is a ten-story condominium on Hibiscus Street in the Rosemary Square area, between One City Plaza and Two City Plaza. Its pool deck is on the sixth floor, and Clematis Street is a few blocks' walk away.
parking: Underground assigned garage parking with valet
description: City Palms is a 10-story building by The Newgard Group at 480 Hibiscus Street in downtown West Palm Beach, between One City Plaza and Two City Plaza and a few blocks from Clematis Street. A sixth-floor amenity pavilion has two sundecks, a heated 70-foot pool, a raised hot tub and a covered outdoor bar and lounge. Other amenities include a fitness center, a club lounge with billiards, a business center and library, and a 24-hour front desk with concierge and valet.

name: The Prado
address: 600 S Dixie Hwy, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Prado is an eight-story condominium on South Dixie Highway, within walking distance of Rosemary Square, the Kravis Center and Clematis Street. Its 304 units range from about 752 to 1,513 square feet, with a pool deck on the fifth floor.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
description: The Prado is an eight-story building with 304 residences at 600 S Dixie Highway in downtown West Palm Beach, near Rosemary Square (formerly CityPlace), completed in 2006. Residences have private balconies with sliding glass doors and open living and dining areas. Amenities include a heated lap pool with outdoor cabanas, a spa, a fitness center, a sauna, a business center and a clubroom, with 24-hour security, an attended lobby and concierge service.

name: The Metropolitan
address: 403 S Sapodilla Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Metropolitan is an eight-story courtyard condominium on South Sapodilla Avenue, about a block from Rosemary Square, with a Venetian-style lobby and a rooftop pool deck.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
description: The Metropolitan is an eight-story building with 149 residences at 403 S Sapodilla Avenue in downtown West Palm Beach, near Rosemary Square and about a block from Clematis Street. Its lobby has marble and Venetian-influenced finishes, and the building has a courtyard, a clubhouse with fitness and business centers, and a heated rooftop pool deck with a spa. Some penthouses and high-floor units have Intracoastal views, and the building has a 24-hour front desk and electronic security.

name: Two City Plaza
address: 701 S Olive Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Two City Plaza is a 21-story condominium tower built by Kolter Homes in 2008, connected to the Rosemary Square district about two blocks from the Intracoastal. It is the sister tower to One City Plaza.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
parking: Covered, assigned garage parking (about 650 spaces) with valet
description: Two City Plaza is a 21-story building by Kolter at 701 S Olive Avenue in downtown West Palm Beach, completed in August 2008 and connected to the Rosemary Square (formerly CityPlace) district, about two blocks from the Intracoastal Waterway. Its 467 residences include 108 penthouse-level residences and 19 live-work units, and the building has an internal parking structure of about 650 spaces. A rooftop amenity deck of about 70,000 square feet includes a heated pool, saunas and an outdoor movie theater, and the building also has a fitness center, zen gardens and a 24-hour concierge.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of Two City Plaza

name: One City Plaza
address: 801 S Olive Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: One City Plaza is a 16-story courtyard-style condominium built by Kolter Homes on South Olive Avenue near Okeechobee Boulevard. It has both traditional condominium units and loft units.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
parking: Controlled underground garage with assigned spaces and valet
description: One City Plaza is a 16-story courtyard-style building by Kolter at 801 S Olive Avenue in downtown West Palm Beach, near Okeechobee Boulevard and the Rosemary Square district. It combines traditional condominium residences with loft-style units. Amenities include a heated rooftop pool with sundeck, a rooftop garden, a fitness center, a sauna and a clubroom, with valet, concierge and 24-hour security.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of One City Plaza

name: CityPlace South Tower
address: 550 Okeechobee Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: CityPlace South Tower is a 420-unit condominium tower on Okeechobee Boulevard, a couple of blocks from Rosemary Square. The Related Group developed it, and it opened in summer 2008.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
parking: Adjoining garage with assigned spaces and valet
description: CityPlace South Tower is a 20-story building developed by The Related Group at 550 Okeechobee Boulevard, at the southern edge of the CityPlace district (now Rosemary Square) in downtown West Palm Beach. Designed by Miami-based Roger Fry & Associates Architects and built by Moss & Associates, it opened in 2008 with 380 tower units, 40 villas and about 9,333 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. An adjoining parking garage has a 22,940-square-foot recreation deck with a pool and spa. The surrounding CityPlace district was master-planned in 1993 by Duany Plater-Zyberk & Co.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of CityPlace South Tower

name: The Tower Condominium at CityPlace
address: 651 Okeechobee Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Tower Condominium at CityPlace is a 12-story condominium on Okeechobee Boulevard in the Rosemary Square area. It is a separate building from CityPlace South Tower at 550 Okeechobee Boulevard.
petPolicy: Pets allowed
description: The Tower Condominium at CityPlace is a 12-story building at 651 Okeechobee Boulevard, within the CityPlace district (now Rosemary Square) in downtown West Palm Beach. Residences are one- and two-bedroom units of about 706 to 1,040 square feet. Building amenities include a heated pool, a spa, an exercise room and a business center.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of The Tower Condominium at CityPlace

name: Courtyards in CityPlace
address: 630, 720 & 780 S Sapodilla Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Courtyards in CityPlace is a mid-rise condominium community of buildings on South Sapodilla Avenue in the Rosemary Square area, with one-, two- and three-bedroom units.
petPolicy: Pets allowed
description: Courtyards in CityPlace is a set of five-story buildings at 630, 720 and 780 S Sapodilla Avenue, near Hibiscus Street, within the CityPlace district (now Rosemary Square) in downtown West Palm Beach. Most residences are one- and two-bedroom units of about 756 to 1,140 square feet, plus a small number of three-bedroom units. Amenities include a heated pool, a spa, an exercise room, a clubroom, a business center and bike storage.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of Courtyards in CityPlace

name: Mr. C Residences West Palm Beach
aka: Mr. C Hotel & Residences West Palm Beach
address: 383 Okeechobee Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
amenities: fitness center with yoga and Pilates rooms
summary: Mr. C Residences West Palm Beach is a 27-story tower under construction at Lakeview Avenue and South Dixie Highway, combining 146 branded condominium residences with 110 hotel suites. Interiors are by Meyer Davis.
rentalPolicy: Owners on select floors may place units in the hotel rental program
description: Mr. C Residences West Palm Beach is a 27-story mixed-use tower under construction at Okeechobee Boulevard and Lakeview Avenue in downtown West Palm Beach, with 146 branded residences above a 110-suite Mr. C hotel. Terra and Sympatico Real Estate are developing it, with architecture by Arquitectonica, interiors by Meyer Davis with Ignazio and Maggio Cipriani, landscaping by Landscape Design Workshop, and KAST Construction as general contractor. It will be the Cipriani-founded Mr. C brand's first property in Palm Beach County. Planned amenities include a garden-level lap pool with cabanas, a fitness center with yoga and Pilates rooms, a spa with steam and sauna, a library and a rooftop pool deck with views of Palm Beach and the Atlantic.

name: Banyan Tree Residences West Palm Beach
address: 400 Hibiscus St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
developer: Mast Capital and Curated JCZM Development, with Banyan Group
summary: Banyan Tree Residences West Palm Beach is a planned 88-residence condominium tower at Hibiscus Street and South Dixie Highway, one block east of Rosemary Square, approved by the Downtown Action Committee in August 2026. Interiors are by Yabu Pushelberg.
parking: Four-level garage in the podium with valet
description: Banyan Tree Residences West Palm Beach is a planned condominium tower with 88 residences and penthouses at 400 Hibiscus Street, on the southeast corner of Hibiscus Street and S Dixie Highway, one block east of Rosemary Square (formerly CityPlace) and several blocks west of the Intracoastal Waterway. Designed by OMA as two interlocking residential volumes above a multi-level podium, it has interiors by Yabu Pushelberg and landscape architecture by Enea. It is the first U.S. residential project under Banyan Group's flagship Banyan Tree brand and replaces the low-rise former home of the Arthritis Foundation. Plans include a full-floor wellness and spa level, a resort-style pool with cabanas, an open-air cinema and about 11,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space.

name: The Residences at 464 Fern Street
address: 464 Fern St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Residences at 464 Fern Street is a proposed 25-story residential tower on a full block bounded by South Dixie Highway, South Quadrille Boulevard, Fern Street and Gardenia Street. Plans filed in June 2026 are in municipal review.
parking: Multi-level podium garage (486 spaces, some in mechanical parking systems)
description: The Residences at 464 Fern Street is a proposed 25-story, roughly 316-foot tower by Related Ross on a 2.64-acre site in downtown West Palm Beach near S Dixie Highway. Designed by Roger Ferris + Partners, the plan calls for 194 residences in two- to four-bedroom layouts and about 4,343 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. Amenities would be concentrated on the fifth floor, including a pool, outdoor bar, fitness center and game room, with a landscaped ground-level garden plaza with public art facing S Dixie Highway.

name: Waterview Towers
address: 400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Waterview Towers is a 132-unit condominium completed in 1981 that sits between Flagler Drive and the Intracoastal Waterway near Clematis Street. Units commonly look out on the Palm Harbor Marina, the Intracoastal and the island of Palm Beach.
parking: Underground assigned garage parking with valet
description: Waterview Towers is a high-rise with 132 residences at 400 N Flagler Drive, completed in 1981 and set between Flagler Drive and the Intracoastal Waterway next to Palm Harbor Marina, just north of the Clematis Street area. Residences look across the Intracoastal toward Palm Beach and The Breakers, the Flagler Memorial Bridge and the Atlantic Ocean. Amenities include a heated pool with sundeck, tennis courts, a fitness center and a clubhouse lounge, with a door attendant, concierge, valet and 24-hour security. The condominium is a leasehold: the Declaration of Condominium was recorded in 1981 on land the building leases from the City of West Palm Beach, so buyers should review the ground lease and its term along with the condominium documents.

name: The Slade
address: 1551 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
amenities: two heated pools (sunrise and sunset decks)
summary: The Slade is a 200-unit condominium completed in 2005 on the west side of North Flagler Drive, about 1.2 miles north of Clematis Street, with views across the Intracoastal. The building is credited to the architecture firm Arquitectonica.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with restrictions (breed, number and size limits)
description: The Slade is a 200-residence condominium completed in 2005 at 1551 N Flagler Drive, about 1.2 miles north of Clematis Street, with units looking out over the Intracoastal Waterway toward the Atlantic. The building was designed by Arquitectonica. Amenities include a marble lobby, 24-hour concierge and valet, two heated pools (one of them indoors), a sunset deck, a fitness center with steam rooms and saunas, a business center and a private dog park. Clematis Street and The Square are about a 15-minute walk away.

name: Flagler Pointe
address: 1801 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Flagler Pointe is a roughly 400-unit condominium complex on North Flagler Drive, made up of a nine-story U-shaped main building and two three-story courtyard buildings. It offers one- to three-bedroom floor plans.
parking: Assigned, numbered garage spaces; no trucks, commercial vehicles, boats or RVs
description: Flagler Pointe is a waterfront condominium community of about 400 residences at 1801 N Flagler Drive, about 1.5 miles from The Square and Clematis Street, with the bridge to Palm Beach island a short drive away. It is laid out as a nine-floor U-shaped building plus two three-story courtyard buildings. Amenities include an Olympic-size heated pool with sundeck and hot tub, a fountained garden, a putting green, a fitness center with saunas, and a clubhouse with a media room, business center and game room. Concierge and security are staffed 24 hours a day.
petPolicy: Up to two pets per unit, 25 lb maximum at maturity; breeds the board deems dangerous are not allowed; pets must be registered; no pets for guests
rentalPolicy: Rentals no more than twice per calendar year, 90-day minimum term; association application and approval required; no subletting

name: Portofino
address: 2600 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Portofino is a 10-story, 125-unit condominium tower from 1969 in the Northwood area. It stands on the east side of Flagler Drive, directly on the Intracoastal Waterway.
petPolicy: One dog or cat per unit (25 lb maximum) and up to two quiet birds; pet deposit required; no visitor pets
parking: One assigned space per unit; guest parking by registration; no overnight trucks, boats, RVs or motorcycles
rentalPolicy: One lease per 12-month period, 3-month minimum and 12-month maximum; no leasing in the first 12 months after purchase; board approval and interview required
description: Portofino is a ten-story, 125-residence condominium built in 1969 on the east side of Flagler Drive in the Northwood area, directly on the Intracoastal Waterway. It is sometimes called Portofino North to tell it apart from Portofino South. Amenities include a heated pool facing the Intracoastal, a clubhouse, a spa, a sauna, a fitness center, a library and a game room. A full-time door attendant and 24/7 security staff the building.

name: Flagler Landing
address: 3940 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Flagler Landing is a four-story condominium completed in 2007 directly on North Flagler Drive in the Northwood Shores area. Its amenities include boat docks and gated security.
description: Flagler Landing is a gated, low-rise waterfront condominium completed in 2007 at 3940 N Flagler Drive, set on a marina on the Intracoastal Waterway beside the Rybovich superyacht marina. It is four stories tall, with Key West-style architecture and 12 floor plans. Amenities include a heated waterfront pool, a fitness center, a spa and private elevators. A limited number of boat slips have been offered for sale, and a guardhouse is staffed 24/7.

name: Placido Mar
address: 5200 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Placido Mar is a 26-story, 145-unit condominium from 1974 in Northwood Harbor, on the Intracoastal side of North Flagler Drive. Listings describe Intracoastal frontage with a boat dock and pier.
description: Placido Mar is a 26-story, 145-residence condominium tower completed in 1974 at 5200 N Flagler Drive in the Northwood Harbor area, on the Intracoastal Waterway. Its gated grounds include a boat dock, a waterfront pier and private beach access. Recreation facilities include a pool, spa, fitness center, sauna, tennis and pickleball courts, a clubhouse and a library.

name: The Palm Beach House
address: 5600 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: The Palm Beach House is a 1978 high-rise condominium on the east side of North Flagler Drive, directly on the Intracoastal Waterway in Northwood Harbor. Listings mention a private sand beach and a waterfront pier.
description: The Palm Beach House is a gated high-rise condominium completed in 1978 on the east side of Flagler Drive at 5600 N Flagler Drive, directly on the Intracoastal Waterway, with eastward views toward Palm Beach island and the ocean. On the grounds are a private sand beach, a heated pool, tennis and pickleball courts, a fitness center, a boat dock and a waterfront pier. Security is staffed 24/7, there is an on-site property manager, and each floor has a laundry room.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of The Palm Beach House

rentalPolicy: Leases of 3 to 12 months, one rental per 12-month period; board approval, orientation, a city rental license and HO-6 insurance required; tenants may not keep pets

name: Alba Palm Beach
address: 4714 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
developer: BGI Companies with Blue Road Group
amenities: private dock with day boat slips
summary: Alba Palm Beach is a 22-story, 55-residence condominium on the Intracoastal in Northwood. It also has two- and three-story townhomes with private plunge pools, and a private dock with direct Intracoastal boat access.
description: Alba Palm Beach is a 22-story, 55-residence waterfront condominium at 4714 N Flagler Drive in Northwood, on the Intracoastal Waterway. Florida YIMBY described it as the first newly completed waterfront residential tower on this stretch of North Flagler. BGI Companies and Blue Road developed it, Spina O'Rourke + Partners designed both the building and the interiors, and Moss Construction built it. The residences include condominiums, townhomes and a six-unit penthouse collection on floors 19–21 with 11-foot ceilings. There is more than 25,000 sq ft of amenity space, including sunrise and sunset pools, a Technogym fitness center, a private dining room with wine storage and private day docks on the Intracoastal.

name: Alba Reserve
address: 4720 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
developer: BGI Companies with Blue Road Group
architect: Carlos Ott with Spina O'Rourke + Partners
amenities: eighth-floor amenity deck with two pools
summary: Alba Reserve is a proposed condominium tower at 4720 N Flagler Drive, next to Alba Palm Beach. In May 2026 the city planning board recommended denial of the rezoning it needs, and the City Commission had not yet voted.
description: Alba Reserve is a proposed condominium tower at 4720 N Flagler Drive (site spanning roughly 4700–4806 N Flagler) in the Northwood Harbor area, next to the completed Alba Palm Beach. The developer is 4700 N. Flagler LLC, a partnership of BGI Cos. and Blue Road Group. The design is by Carlos Ott with Spina O'Rourke + Partners. The original 2025 filing called for townhomes, penthouses and three-bedroom condominiums of 1,440 to 3,505 sq ft, with an eighth-floor amenity deck holding two pools and guest suites. The project needs a rezoning and waivers, and in May 2026 the city planning board voted 6–1 to recommend denial.

name: Apogee
address: 4906 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Apogee is a proposed Related Group condominium on a 1.45-acre waterfront site in the Northwood Harbor area, reduced from earlier plans for 25 stories and 46 units.
description: Apogee is a planned condominium tower from Miami-based Related Group on a waterfront parcel of about 1.5 acres at 4906 N Flagler Drive, north of Currie Park and near the Northwood Harbor Historic District. The first proposal was a 25-story, 46-unit tower, and the planning board recommended rejecting it in December 2023. The developer then scaled it down to a 21-story tower with 39 residences. The planning board recommended the rezoning in January 2025, and the City Commission later rezoned the site to a Residential Planned Development. Related Group is not affiliated with Related Cos., the New York firm led by Stephen Ross.

name: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, West Palm Beach
aka: Mandarin Oriental Residences, West Palm Beach
address: 5400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
architect: Safdie Architects with Spina O'Rourke + Partners
summary: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental is a planned 31-story, 87-residence branded condominium on a three-acre Intracoastal site on North Flagler Drive. Interiors are by Studio Munge.
description: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, West Palm Beach is a planned 31-story, 87-residence tower at 5400 N Flagler Drive, with direct frontage on the Intracoastal Waterway and every residence overlooking the water. Great Gulf is developing it, Safdie Architects (led by Moshe Safdie) is the architect, Studio Munge is doing the interiors, and ENEA Landscape Architecture is doing the landscape. Each residence will have private elevator access and a wraparound balcony. The residences include two- to four-bedroom units, two multi-level villas and a full-floor penthouse. Planned amenities include a rooftop pool and spa with a fitness center, a ground-level pool with a bar, a pickleball court and a garden lounge. The roughly three-acre site was previously the Poinsettia Apartments, a 1966 complex.

name: The Ritz-Carlton Residences, West Palm Beach
address: 1717 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: The Ritz-Carlton Residences, West Palm Beach is a 27-story, 138-residence branded condominium on North Flagler Drive by the water. Interiors are by Rockwell Group.
description: The Ritz-Carlton Residences, West Palm Beach is a 27-story, 138-residence condominium tower under construction at 1717 N Flagler Drive on the Intracoastal Waterway. Every residence faces east toward Palm Beach and the Atlantic. Related Group and BH Group are developing it in partnership with Marriott International. Arquitectonica designed the building, Rockwell Group the interiors and Naturalficial the landscape. Residences will have private elevator access, floor-to-ceiling glass and large terraces. Planned amenities include a bayfront pool deck with cabanas, a spa, a fitness center, coworking spaces, a gaming lounge with a golf simulator and Cove Club membership access, with services provided by Ritz-Carlton staff.

name: Olara
address: 1919 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Olara is a two-tower waterfront development on North Flagler Drive: a 26-story tower with 275 condominiums alongside a separate rental tower. Interiors and amenity spaces are by Gabellini Sheppard Associates.
description: Olara is a 275-residence waterfront condominium under construction at 1919 N Flagler Drive, with views of the Intracoastal Waterway, Palm Beach island and the Atlantic. New York-based Savanna is the developer, Arquitectonica the architect, and Gabellini Sheppard Associates is designing the interiors and amenities. More than 80,000 sq ft of amenity space is planned, including a spa managed by Arch Amenities, an Olympic-size lap pool, a 192-foot private marina reaching into the Intracoastal with dedicated slips, and a restaurant from José Andrés Group. Residents will also have access to Sollis Health medical services.

name: Shorecrest
address: 1865 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
amenities: rooftop pool deck with 75-foot lap pool
summary: Shorecrest is a 28-story, 98-residence condominium on North Flagler Drive with four residences per floor. Interiors are by Rottet Studio.
description: Shorecrest is a 28-story, 98-residence condominium tower under construction on North Flagler Drive, across the Intracoastal Waterway from Palm Beach island. Related Ross is the developer, Roger Ferris + Partners the architect and Rottet Studio the interior designer. With no more than four residences per floor, units will have views of the Intracoastal, the Atlantic and Palm Beach island. About 18,355 sq ft of amenities are planned with Equinox, including a rooftop pool deck with a 75-foot lap pool, cold plunge, saunas and steam rooms, a golf simulator and a private dining room. Downtown West Palm Beach, CityPlace, Brightline and the redeveloped Currie Park are all nearby.

name: Rosewood Residences West Palm Beach
address: 2001 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Rosewood Residences is a planned 27-story, 90-residence condominium on a waterfront site on North Flagler Drive, approved by the City of West Palm Beach in June 2026.
description: Rosewood Residences West Palm Beach is a planned 27-story, 90-residence branded condominium at 2001 N Flagler Drive, on a waterfront site that now holds a medical office building completed in 2001. Related Group and BH Group are developing it, and Arquitectonica is the architect. Residences are planned to average about 3,400 sq ft. Planned amenities include more than 13,000 sq ft of indoor space and a fifth-floor pool deck. It will be Rosewood's fourth branded residential address in South Florida.

name: Washington Tower
address: 2000 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Washington Tower is a 20-story, 114-unit condominium from 1972 in the gated Lands of the President community on Presidential Way, in the north end of West Palm Beach.
description: Washington Tower is a 20-story, 114-residence condominium built in 1972 at 2000 Presidential Way in the Lands of the President community. It is one of three 1972 towers there, along with Lincoln and Jefferson. The community is gated with 24-hour security, Lake Mangonia forms most of its eastern edge, and its buildings are set around the Banyan Cay resort's Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course. Building amenities include a doorman, a fitness room and a social room. Downtown West Palm Beach, Clematis Street and The Square are within about three miles.

name: Envoy Tower
address: 2480 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Envoy Tower is a 19-story, 148-unit condominium completed in 1984, part of the gated Lands of the President complex on Presidential Way.
parking: One assigned open or covered space per unit; additional covered spaces are sold separately; no trucks, commercial vehicles, boats or trailers overnight
description: Envoy Tower is a 148-residence high-rise condominium built in 1984 at 2480 Presidential Way in the gated Lands of the President community. Its residences are mostly two- and three-bedroom layouts. The community borders Lake Mangonia and the Banyan Cay resort's Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course, and it is a few miles from downtown West Palm Beach and President Donald J. Trump International Airport (PBI). Building amenities include a doorman, a clubhouse, a sauna, a hot tub and a tennis court.
petPolicy: Owners may keep up to two household pets, each under 15 lb; pets must be carried in hallways; tenants and guests may not keep pets
rentalPolicy: No leasing in the first 24 months of ownership; leases of 3 to 12 months, one per 12-month period; rentals capped at 10% of units building-wide; no corporate buyers or tenants; board approval required

name: The Bristol
address: 1100 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
architect: Solomon Cordwell Buenz with Revuelta Architecture International
summary: The Bristol is a 25-story condominium tower on the Intracoastal Waterway on South Flagler Drive, completed in 2019. Its residences have three to five bedrooms, up to a full-floor penthouse.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with breed restrictions and a limit on number of pets
parking: 24-hour valet and private two- and three-car air-conditioned garages
description: The Bristol is a glass condominium tower on the Intracoastal Waterway beside the Royal Park Bridge on West Palm Beach's South Flagler corridor. Residences look out over the Intracoastal, the ocean and Palm Beach Island. Solomon Cordwell Buenz designed it with Revuelta Architecture International, taking the shape from the idea of a yacht and its wake, and Amir Khamneipur did the interiors. The tower stands on the former Chapel-by-the-Lake site, and construction ran from 2016 to late 2019.

name: Edgeworth
address: 1155 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Edgeworth is a planned pair of curved 28-story condominium towers on South Flagler Drive, with interiors by MAWD (March and White Design). Construction is expected to start in 2027.
description: Edgeworth is a planned waterfront condominium by Related Ross at 1155 South Flagler Drive, next to the developer's South Flagler House. Kohn Pedersen Fox designed it as two curved 28-story towers, with residential interiors by MAWD | March and White Design. Each residence will have a private elevator and private balconies facing the ocean and the Intracoastal. Plans include more than 90,000 square feet of amenities centered on spa, fitness and social spaces.

name: Trianon
address: 1200 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Trianon is a high-rise condominium completed in 1972 on the Intracoastal side of South Flagler Drive, with two-bedroom, two-bath floor plans.
description: Trianon is an early-1970s waterfront high-rise on South Flagler Drive, on the West Palm Beach side of the Intracoastal Waterway, with water views toward Palm Beach. Most residences have two bedrooms and two baths with private balconies. Amenities include a waterfront heated pool, an exercise room, a community room, extra storage, and doorman service with on-site management. The building sits along the Flagler Drive waterfront path near downtown and the Norton Museum of Art.

name: Forté on Flagler
address: 1333 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
developer: Two Roads Development and Alpha Blue Ventures
summary: Forté on Flagler is a 25-story condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway with interiors by Jean-Louis Deniot. It topped off in April 2024, and closings began in July 2025.
parking: Valet service, house cars and EV charging
description: Forté on Flagler is a cylinder-shaped tower about 300 feet tall on the Intracoastal Waterway on South Flagler Drive, designed by Bernardo Fort-Brescia of Arquitectonica with interiors by Jean-Louis Deniot. Most floors have two flow-through residences, which can be combined into a full-floor home, and ceilings are at least 10 feet. The amenity levels include a pool deck with a 75-foot lap pool and heated spa, a wellness suite with steam room and sauna, a fitness center, yoga studio, theater, private dining room and guest suites. The building topped out in April 2024, and closings began in July 2025.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of Forté on Flagler

name: South Flagler House
address: 1355 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: South Flagler House is a pair of identical 28-story condominium towers on the Intracoastal Waterway, with interiors by Pembrooke & Ives. The project topped out in November 2025, and residents are expected in 2027.
description: South Flagler House is Related Ross's two-tower condominium on a 3-acre Intracoastal site just east of the Norton Museum of Art, overlooking Palm Beach Island and the Atlantic Ocean. Robert A.M. Stern Architects designed two identical 28-story towers rising from a base lined with stepped gardens, with interiors by Pembrooke & Ives. Plans call for about 50,000 square feet of amenities, including a resort-style pool deck, fitness and wellness facilities, private dining rooms, an indoor pickleball court, a theater, and a library and card room. The project broke ground in April 2024 and topped out in November 2025.

name: La Clara
address: 200 Arkona Ct, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: La Clara is a 25-story condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway with one- to four-bedroom residences. Its facade combines stucco, Roman travertine, coral stone and granite.
petPolicy: Pets allowed with breed, number and size restrictions
description: La Clara is a 25-story, 83-residence condominium by Great Gulf on the Intracoastal Waterway on South Flagler Drive, with views of the Intracoastal and Palm Beach Island. Siamak Hariri of Hariri Pontarini Architects was the design architect, with Stantec as architect of record, and the building was designed to capture sky and water exposures. Residences have one to three bedrooms, and the full-floor penthouse has four bedrooms and more than 3,500 square feet of terraces. Unit addresses in many records use 200 Arkona Court.

name: Viking Arms
address: 1527 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Viking Arms is a three-story condominium on South Flagler Drive near the Norton Museum of Art, built in 1980.
description: Viking Arms is a three-story condominium built in 1980 at 1527 S Flagler Drive, in the Mango Promenade area south of downtown West Palm Beach. It is a gated community with elevators. Association amenities include a pool and sauna, a recreation room and a bike room.

name: Rapallo North
address: 1701 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Rapallo North is the northern of the two Rapallo condominium towers on the Intracoastal side of South Flagler Drive, built in 1973.
petPolicy: Pets allowed
description: Rapallo North is the north tower of the 1973 Rapallo complex on South Flagler Drive, in the Mango Promenade area, with Intracoastal Waterway views and a short walk or bike ride to downtown. The full-service building has a doorman, on-site management and maintenance staff. Amenities include a heated pool, exercise room, sauna, clubhouse, library, media room and bike storage.

name: Rapallo South
address: 1801 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Rapallo South is the southern of the two Rapallo condominium towers on South Flagler Drive, built in 1973, just north of the El Cid neighborhood.
petPolicy: Pets allowed, with restrictions
description: Rapallo South is the south tower of the 1973 Rapallo complex on South Flagler Drive, on the Intracoastal Waterway, where upper-floor residences look over the Intracoastal toward Palm Beach. The building has a 24-hour doorman and attended lobby. Amenities include a heated pool, fitness center, sauna, clubhouse, library, media room, business center and a courtyard garden.

name: Flagler Yacht Club
address: 3701 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33405
summary: Flagler Yacht Club is a small boutique condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway on South Flagler Drive, built in 1981, with a marina for residents.
petPolicy: Pets allowed
description: Flagler Yacht Club is a low-rise waterfront condominium built in 1981 on the Intracoastal Waterway at 3701 S Flagler Drive, in the Central Park area of West Palm Beach, made up of North and South buildings. Some residences come with private boat slips maintained by the association. Amenities include a clubhouse, pool, fitness center, sauna, waterfront pier, bike room and storage.

photo.alt: Artist's rendering of Flagler Yacht Club

name: Maison d'Or
address: 3705 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33405
developer: Kolter Urban and Perko Development Partners
amenities: elevated pool deck with spa and cabanas
summary: Maison d'Or is a planned 19-story, 39-residence boutique condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway, with interiors by Hirsch Bedner Associates. It replaces the former Flagler House condominium, and sales launched in January 2026.
description: Maison d'Or is a planned 19-story, 39-residence condominium by Kolter Urban and Perko Development Partners at 3705 South Flagler Drive, overlooking the Intracoastal Waterway and Palm Beach Island. 10 Design is the architect, Hirsch Bedner Associates the interior designer and EDSA the landscape architect. Two- and three-bedroom residences fill the middle floors, four-bedroom residences the upper floors, and a full-floor penthouse of more than 10,000 square feet crowns the tower, with east- and west-facing terraces on every home. Delivery is targeted for late 2028.

name: Lincoln Tower
address: 2400 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Lincoln Tower is a 20-story condominium built in 1972 inside the gated Lands of the President community, overlooking the community's golf course.
description: Lincoln Tower stands at 2400 Presidential Way within Lands of the President, the gated golf community north of downtown West Palm Beach. Listing sources date the building to 1972 and describe it as 20 stories, with one- to three-bedroom residences of roughly 894 to 1,884 square feet. Building amenities cited in listings include a pool, fitness center, clubhouse, library, storage and a doorman, and listings report recent work including a new roof, cooling tower, lobby, elevators and generator and concrete restoration. The county property appraiser lists the condominium as Lands of the President Condo 3.

name: Jefferson Tower
address: 2425 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Jefferson Tower is a 1974 high-rise condominium at 2425 Presidential Way in the gated Lands of the President community.
description: Jefferson Tower is one of the high-rise condominiums of Lands of the President, the gated golf community off Congress Avenue in West Palm Beach. Listing sources give a 1974 completion date and residences of about 894 to 1,499 square feet with one and two bedrooms. Amenities reported in listings include a secure lobby with doorman, pool, fitness center, social room, library, sauna and storage, and one listing notes the building completed its 40-year recertification. Views cited include the golf course, lake and city.

name: Parliament East
address: 2427 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Parliament East is a 12-story, 1982 condominium in Lands of the President with larger residences of roughly 2,000 to 3,200 square feet.
description: Parliament East sits at 2427 Presidential Way next to Jefferson Tower inside the gated Lands of the President community. Listing sources date it to 1982 and describe a 12-story mid-rise with only four residences per floor, with two- and three-bedroom units of about 2,028 to 2,588 square feet (one source cites up to 3,209). Reported amenities include a pool, spa, fitness center and concierge service, with golf, lake and city views.

name: Yorktown
address: 1500 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Yorktown is an eight-story, 48-unit condominium built in 1972 at the east end of Presidential Way.
description: Yorktown is a mid-rise condominium at 1500 Presidential Way, near the Lands of the President community in West Palm Beach. Compass lists it as an eight-story building with 48 residences completed in 1972, with two-bedroom, two-bath units of roughly 996 to 1,194 square feet common in listings. Amenities listed include an elevator, clubhouse, gym, cabana, tennis court and on-site laundry, and some listings say the building has passed its 50-year recertification.

name: Lakeshore Club
address: 1830 Embassy Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Lakeshore Club is a 1974 elevator condominium on Lake Mangonia within the gated Lands of the President community.
description: Lakeshore Club occupies 1830 Embassy Drive inside Lands of the President, with listings describing a gated setting on Lake Mangonia. Sources give a 1974 construction date and block construction, with units on at least the sixth floor, and amenities including a pool, fitness center, clubhouse, elevators and an on-site property manager. The legal name in listings is Lakeshore Club Condo.

name: The Berkeley Palm Beach
address: 550 S Australian Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Berkeley Palm Beach is a 25-story, 193-residence condominium tower under construction on the Clear Lake edge of downtown West Palm Beach, by the developer of The Bristol.
description: The Berkeley Palm Beach is rising at 550 South Australian Avenue on the western, Clear Lake side of downtown West Palm Beach. Developed by Al Adelson, who also built The Bristol, and designed by Arquitectonica with John Moriarty & Associates as general contractor, the 25-story tower will hold 193 two- to five-bedroom residences with flow-through layouts and large terraces. Planned amenities include a seventh-floor resort pool and spa, a rooftop pool, fitness and wellness spaces and private dining. Construction broke ground and concrete pours were under way by mid-2026, with completion targeted for 2029; Douglas Elliman handles sales.

name: The Edge
address: 300 S Australian Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Edge is a 2007 condominium of 307 residences on Clear Lake at Australian Avenue, west of downtown West Palm Beach.
description: The Edge occupies 300 South Australian Avenue along Clear Lake, on the western edge of downtown West Palm Beach. Completed in 2007, the building contains 307 residences and offers a large amenity package including a lakeside heated pool and spa, an indoor pool, a clubhouse with fitness center, business center, billiards and game rooms, tennis and bocce courts and 24-hour security. Units feature 10-foot ceilings and in-unit laundry, and a 2014 bulk sale of 32 units to an investment fund was reported in the trade press.

name: The Montecito
address: 616 Clearwater Park Rd, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Montecito is a 16-story, 186-unit gated condominium completed in 2003 on Clearwater Park Road near Clear Lake.
description: The Montecito stands at 616 Clearwater Park Road, just west of downtown West Palm Beach between Australian Avenue and Clear Lake. CondoBlackBook lists it as a 16-story building of 186 residences completed in 2003, and listings describe a gated property with a heated pool and spa, sauna, fitness center, billiards and business rooms, a community room and garage parking, with floor plans marketed under the Aruba, Cayman and Montecito names. Listings describe pets as permitted subject to restrictions.

name: One Watermark Place
address: 622 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: One Watermark Place is a 15-story, 48-residence waterfront condominium at the foot of the Flagler Memorial Bridge, completed in 2003.
description: One Watermark Place is a 15-story condominium of 48 residences on North Flagler Drive where the Flagler Memorial Bridge meets the Intracoastal Waterway. Listing sources give a 2003 completion and describe open-plan residences with private elevator lobbies and large terraces. Amenities reported include a guarded entry with concierge and valet, a heated waterfront pool and spa, a fitness center with saunas, a movie theater and a 22-slip marina for vessels up to about 100 feet. Palm Beach County records show the 48 residences across two condominium phases at the address.

name: The Whitney
address: 410 Evernia St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Whitney is an eight-story condominium on Evernia Street at Quadrille Boulevard in downtown West Palm Beach, completed in 2007, with 190 residences over ground-floor shops.
description: The Whitney is an eight-story condominium at 410 Evernia Street in downtown West Palm Beach, completed in 2007, a block from Rosemary Square. Palm Beach County records show 190 residential condominium units plus commercial units at street level. Listings describe one- to three-bedroom residences, with the largest around 2,000 square feet. Reported amenities include a rooftop pool, fitness center, 24-hour concierge and garage parking.

name: Villa Lofts
address: 1617 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Villa Lofts is a boutique 36-residence condominium on North Flagler Drive between The Slade and the Ritz-Carlton Residences site, completed in 2006.
description: Villa Lofts is a boutique condominium at 1617 North Flagler Drive, between The Slade and the Ritz-Carlton Residences site, facing the Intracoastal across Flagler Drive. Listing sources give a 2006 build year and describe loft-style one- to three-bedroom residences with glass-railed balconies and only a few homes per floor. Palm Beach County records show 36 condominium units in the building; a smaller sister condominium, Villa Del Lago, shares the address. Reported amenities include two pools, a spa, a sauna and a fitness center.

amenities: Heated saltwater pool on the Intracoastal
name: La Fontana
address: 2800 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: La Fontana is a 10-story waterfront cooperative built in 1961 on North Flagler Drive in Northwood Shores.
description: La Fontana is a ten-story building at 2800 North Flagler Drive in the Northwood Shores area, built in 1961 on the Intracoastal Waterway. Palm Beach County records it as a cooperative rather than a condominium, so buyers purchase shares in the corporation that owns the building with a proprietary lease on their apartment; lenders and association approval rules can differ from a condo. Bex describes one- to three-bedroom units of roughly 650 to 1,470 square feet, with east-facing units looking over the water. Reported amenities include a heated pool and lawns on the Intracoastal, a fitness center, a recreation room, 24/7 security with a lobby attendant and underground parking.

name: Regency Surf & Racquet Club
address: 4500 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Regency Surf & Racquet Club is a four-story, 95-unit condominium on North Flagler Drive in Northwood Harbor, between Flagler Landing and Alba Palm Beach.
description: Regency Surf & Racquet Club is an established low-rise condominium at 4500 North Flagler Drive in the Northwood Harbor area of West Palm Beach, facing the Intracoastal across Flagler Drive. Palm Beach County records show 95 condominium units on four floors. Building-level details such as the year built and amenities were not confirmed in a published source.

name: Norton Park Place
address: 1501 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Norton Park Place is a 64-unit condominium on South Flagler Drive beside La Clara, with two-bedroom residences of roughly 1,000 to 1,125 square feet.
description: Norton Park Place is a condominium at 1501 South Flagler Drive, between La Clara and Viking Arms, facing the Intracoastal across Flagler Drive. Palm Beach County records show 64 condominium units, and listings show two-bedroom residences of about 1,000 to 1,125 square feet on floors three through eight. Reported amenities include a heated pool, clubhouse and fitness center. The year built was not confirmed in a published source.

name: Portofino South
address: 3800 Washington Rd, West Palm Beach, FL 33405
summary: Portofino South is a 12-story, 140-unit waterfront condominium built in 1971 at 3800 Washington Road, one block north of Southern Boulevard.
description: Portofino South is a twelve-story condominium of 140 units at 3800 Washington Road, where South Flagler Drive meets Washington Road one block north of Southern Boulevard. Built in 1971, it offers one- to three-bedroom units, many with Intracoastal views, and Palm Beach County records show the 140 units across two condominium phases. Listings report a 24-hour door attendant, heated pool, fitness center, sauna, boat dock and covered parking, and Bex notes a recently completed concrete restoration. It is a different building from Portofino at 2600 N Flagler Drive.
